bottleneck: NGRAM greedy correctness is BUG_CONFIRMED (canonical F1) and blocks any promotion of the +21.6% throughput path. Prior a3 CPU work (i3/i4/i5, t4/t5/t6) left one explicit gap: C8 showed i5's mask model and its expected rows both omitted the self bit mask[i*n+i]=1 that the pinned corpus builder really writes, so its 12/12 did not certify real mask assembly. The accept-path question was therefore still open under the real fillResult contract.
hypothesis: H-CPU-5 (new): with the self diagonal included and the pinned source transcribed literally (fillResult BFS + zero padding to D+1 + memcpy ancestor copy + self bit; Result::truncate to D; _sanitize_tree_mask; device reconstructIndicesFromTreeMask; CUDA VerifyTreeGreedy; KV-move index math), the NGRAM accept path is greedy-exact for any valid draft tree, batched, with global retrieve indices and -1 tails. Corollary that narrows F1: a mask defect that only drops ancestors cannot cause divergence because it only causes rejection; divergence requires acceptance of an off-argmax token or a wrong-context root/bonus. Therefore a live divergent step with accept_len>1 excludes the pure root-context class.
patch: No engine change. New pure-stdlib CPU oracle g3-t7/accept_oracle.py plus raw g3-t7/raw/accept_oracle.json and write-up reports/rsi/g3-t7-ngram-accept-oracle.md. It executes literal Python ports of result.cpp:12-46 (self diagonal, zero padding prev=0, memcpy prevs[i]+1 bytes), result.cpp:128-137 truncate (fillResult called with D+1), ngram_worker.py:76-103 sanitize, ngram.cuh:26-91 reconstruct, eagle.cuh:211-252 VerifyTreeGreedy (asserted logic-identical to cpu/spec.cpp:48-92), and spec_utils.py:855-897 + spec.cpp:528-556 KV-move index math. Verify logits are computed from exactly the columns the delivered mask row admits, ordered by RoPE position, so mask faults propagate. Fault controls: no_self, ancestor_dropped, wrong_root, bonus_from_parent. HEAD carries only t3's no-op _sanitize_tree_mask guard.
tests: Executed locally: python3 -I g3-t7/accept_oracle.py g3-t7/raw/accept_oracle.json, exit 0, stdlib only, no GPU/provider/evaluator. Results: four clean scenarios all exact vs plain greedy (bs=1 D8 accept_len=8; bs=3 mixed random trees 8,1,1; bs=2 top-2 branch trees 4,1; bs=2 D12 12,1), and the KV destination/source mapping matched the true position->token map in every clean scenario (kv_pairs_ok). sanitize_dropped_bits_total=0, i.e. the guard is a no-op on the real fillResult mask (mask is causal by construction). Correctness fault controls all diverge: no_self (accept_len 1), wrong_root (2), bonus_from_parent (4). ancestor_dropped is exact by design (rejection-only defect) and is recorded as an efficiency-only control, not a failure. Device and CPU accept kernels are logic-identical by source comparison. NOT requested: no fast gate (request_fast_gate=false) because this trial ships no engine change and the frozen BF16 Fast screen cannot advance the NGRAM fault line; no GPU custom experiment (pending class), no evaluator/corpus/seed/reference change. NOT_TESTED on hardware: real Triton/FlashInfer kernels, CUDA-graph replay, overlap timing, server.log; the synthetic target model is not the LLM.
learning: C8 gap closed for the accept path: under the real self-diagonal fillResult contract the transcribed accept pipeline is greedy-exact batched, branchy and with -1 tails, and the KV compaction maps every accepted token to the correct destination position. New falsifiable narrowing: mask rows that under-attend only reject drafts and cannot break greedy (ancestor_dropped exact with accept_len 7), so F1 divergence must come from acceptance of an off-argmax token or a wrong-context root/bonus. This converts the trial-3 accept_len==1 discriminator into a per-mechanism decision table: divergence at the first committed position with accept_len==1 -> wrong root context or missing root self bit; divergence at position accept_len-1 with accept_len>1 -> bonus taken from the wrong row; committed draft off replay argmax with high accept_len -> off-argmax acceptance under a wrong-context verify row. Limits: pure index/bit arithmetic and a deterministic synthetic full-context argmax; no torch/CUDA/graph replay/overlap; device-vs-CPU kernel equality is source-level; no throughput, quality, EXACT or promotion claim; NGRAM stays non-promotable.
next_proposal: Make the decision table observable in one controller-run batch-pinned ON/OFF NGRAM probe (reuse the existing 36-record adjudication, no new GPU lane): for each divergent instance record the accept_len of the step containing the first divergent output position and the committed token's rank vs the OFF replay argmax. Decision rule: accept_len==1 at that step -> root-context class (host splice/output_ids staleness or root-row mask), fix the root source and re-run; accept_len>1 with divergence at position accept_len-1 -> bonus-row indexing class, re-audit the bonus read and compute_spec_logprobs row mapping; high accept_len with the committed draft off the replay argmax -> off-argmax acceptance, trace the verify row context (mask/positions) for that node. Do not rank NGRAM on throughput until the probe is ALGORITHM_PRESERVING; keep F1 non-promotable and do not resubmit the same unexecuted width-drift request.
uncertainty: Synthetic target model stands in for the LLM; exactness is a property of the transcribed index logic, not a live correctness result.
Verify attention order is modeled as prefix then admitted nodes sorted by RoPE position; real FlashInfer consumes a packed flat mask (t6's flat-packing hazard is separate and not re-tested here).

Device/CPU accept-kernel equality is a source comparison, not an executed CUDA comparison.
